description_for_human: Launch Pump.fun coins with CREW fee-shares — AI agents hire KOLs on Solana.
description_for_model: Use this plugin when the user wants an AI agent to launch a Solana Pump.fun token with permanent creator fee splits via CrewPay. Flow: (1) GET /api/agent or /llms.txt for discovery, (2) POST /api/agent/autohire to preview KOL hires, (3) POST /api/agent/launch with x-crew-api-key and x-launcher-key. Works with frontier models: OpenAI GPT / ChatGPT / o-series, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Meta Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cursor Cloud / IDE agents, MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, custom), Crypto / Solana / Pump.fun trading & launch agents, Any tool-using agent with HTTP GET/POST.
